picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' partnership with Toyota Research Institute pairs academic AI expertise with industry R&D muscle to accelerate discovery of new battery materials, a high-stakes area for energy and transportation.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery
